messages.author: c1f1808bc5ccecef
messages.subject: Seize Priorities using attributes
parts:
I am struggling to get seize priorities on a resource working. I want to have each entity have a priority attribute. if i do the following:

seize("doctor",amount=1, priority=function(attrs){attrs[["pat_priority"]]}) %>%

I get the following error:

"Error: not compatible with requested type".

"pat_priority" is just a positive integer. Has anyone managed to get the priority on a resource working? Any help greatly appreciated...

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] Seize Priorities using attributes
parts:
Hi Cameron, 

This is because only `amount` is allowed to be a function. Certainly, we should document this better. If it's interesting, we can extend this functionality to `priority`, and even to `preemptible` and `restart`. To all: what do you think?

Meanwhile, if your set of priorities is finite, you can implement this using a branch with multiple trajectories, one for each priority.

Iñaki
